t: A game-based, wordless coding app for young children from the BEGiN family.
steps: Open the BEGiN site, where codespark.com now redirects.
Look for the BEGiN educators page.
Ask BEGiN to confirm free classroom access for your school.
Create a class in the teacher dashboard.
Ask BEGiN which devices are supported. The platform list is unknown.
